description:
## Why This Exists

post/log_append.rs::append_to_groups() uses debug_assert_eq! to verify that hlc_timestamps.len() == newsgroups.len(). In release builds, a caller that passes mismatched lengths will silently zip the shorter slice, skipping log entries for some groups. This is a data integrity issue: the article would be stored in article_numbers for all groups but only have log entries for the min(timestamps, groups) groups.

## Acceptance Criteria

Change debug_assert_eq to a runtime check that returns Err(Response::new(441, ...)) when lengths mismatch. Delete the debug_assert.
title: log_append.rs: HLC timestamps passed as slice with debug_assert only
